digest.component_or_area: rich-text reconciliation engine cutover (Cloud ADF + DC wiki rendering)
propositions: State-based echo suppression via baseline diff (current Jira value vs last-synced baseline) must replace codec-law gating because DC's codec is lossy and decode(encode(x))≠x cannot reliably prevent loops.

Cloud send path must route through AdfCodec functions pointing to adf.py markdown-aware functions (markdown_to_adf, adf_to_markdown, normalize as composition), while DC send path must compose to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) to emit rendered wiki on both issue.update() AND CREATE, with rendering NOT applied by plain/identity codec when cutover flag is OFF.

Local-side baseline comparison must normalize through RichTextCodec.normalize_outbound (decode∘to_wire) while emit/remote comparison uses inbound-decoded remote unchanged, preserving two distinct compare paths that prevent lossy round-trip artifacts from masking baseline divergence.

An inline change-gated 8-byte rich_sha counter must persist in binding record, reset on wire change or baseline refresh, and trigger exactly one GET at equality threshold (2 consecutive identical renders) to break divergence loops without per-pass timestamp churn.

Concurrent both-sides body edit must remain local-wins (existing behavior per a713) while raising outbound-field-conflict alert, and Jira-native constructs (panels/mentions/dates) must survive edit-free rebar passes under origin-gating (local≠baseline fires only).

Cutover must tolerate absent marklas extra by degrading to plain-text ADF path rather than raising, and must disable entirely when flag is OFF (config key reconciler.rich_text_cutover, default OFF), reverting both send paths to identity wire.
